title: Banks Act Circular 1/2026 — Status of Previously Issued Circulars and Directives
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)
sourceNote: Annual status circular confirming which previously issued PA circulars and directives remain effective for 2026. Contains 18 effective circulars (s.2) and 69 effective directives (s.3). Directives under s.6(6) of the Banks Act remain effective until formally withdrawn; they are not subject to the annual confirmation process that applies to circulars.
applicableTo: auditors of banks or controlling companies

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
1.1       All previously issued Banks Act circulars are deemed to be withdrawn, terminated or
          replaced, except if such a circular is to remain effective and is then accordingly
          confirmed in Circular 1 of that year. The circulars that remain effective will retain their
          original numbers and dates.

sections.heading: Effective directives issued in terms of the Banks Act
sections.text:
Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act prescribes that the PA may, following consultation
       with the relevant bank, controlling company, eligible institution or auditor of a bank or
       controlling company, issue a directive to such a bank, controlling company, eligible
       institution or auditor of a bank or controlling company, either individually or
       collectively, regarding the application of the Banks Act.

       The PA issued a number of directives in terms of section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act. It
       is hereby confirmed that all such issued directives will remain effective until such time
       as they are withdrawn in writing by the PA in terms of section 6(6)(c) of the Banks
       Act.
